ok: Well, it took. Even I'm a little surprised.
The metal's listening for once. Strange day.
Well, would you look at that. Doubted my own eyes.
The hammering paid off. Huh.
Done. No idea why, though.
Metal must be in a good mood today.
Well, it came out clean. Who knew.
Figured it'd shatter. It didn't.
Years at the forge and this still gets me.
Hm. Came out fine. Just saying.
Watching that had my jaw hanging open.
Lucky. Ah, scratch that.
Felt it in my fingertips. And it really worked.
All I did was swing a hammer, you know.
It works. Yeah, that's enough.
Metal takes our side once in a while.
Did you hear that? Rang clear as a bell.
The things this thing does. It actually worked!
Harder now. My hands still have it.
The quiet ones that climb are the scary ones.
Ah, sometimes it just goes that way.
Wait, did I make that?
Success. Now I'm thinking about a drink.
Looks like the metal's smiling. My imagination?
Looks like the anvil helped this time!
Yep, it took. Take it.
Look at those sparks. Good to see after so long.
Honestly figured it wouldn't. Didn't say so.
This is why I can't put the hammer down.
Still in one piece. Living long has its perks.
Before it even cooled? Isn't that cheating?
The quench water's going to be shocked.
Worth all that bellows work.
This lump's got more grit than I thought.
Let's see. Not a scratch on it.
Ha. The metal taught me something.
Makes no sense, but it's right here, so what can I do.
Take it. I won't take it back.
The metal smells different. In a good way.
My hands knew first on this one.
Came out fine by accident. Just by accident.
Tougher than it looks.
The hammer feels oddly light today.
Had a crowd, they'd have applauded.
Metal caught its breath and stood up straight.
Huh, I never thought the iron would listen this well.
Got one. Not bragging about it.
The forge fire pulled its weight.
Things like this happen on the anvil, huh.
That's worth what the metal cost, at least.
fail: Not broken, so why the long face?
At least it didn't fall off. Tsk.
Looks like the iron's in a mood today.
Even the iron went easy on you there.
Loosen up, the hammer's startled.
A slip at the low end is no blemish.
Just hammer it again. Iron's not going anywhere.
Expected too much from the iron, didn't you.
Heh, the iron was stubborn this time.
Didn't fall off? Not bad at all.
Fire wasn't hot enough, maybe. I'll take the blame.
This doesn't even count as a failure.
It didn't take this time. The fire's still lit, so go again.
Did you hear the iron yawn just now?
If you're sore about it, go hit it again.
Hands still in one piece? Then it's fine.
No shame in the hammering. Blame the iron.
Won't come off. This stuff's tough.
Stop pouting and get back to the anvil.
Let's see... not a scratch on it.
Days like this happen. Go have some tea.
Iron's not ready for it yet, I guess.
Nothing lost. Laugh it off.
When I was young, I missed worse than this.
Long as it didn't shatter, it's a win.
Ugh, the iron's shy today.
That's nothing. Even the anvil would yawn.
Same as before. Still, that's something.
Sigh and the embers die. Shh.
Failed and still in one piece. Well, look at that.
One more pump of the bellows might change things.
Just sweated a bit. That dries fast.
Fine. Let's say the iron just caught its breath.
Anvil's fine, iron's fine. What's the problem?
Huh. All noise, nothing to show for it.
Don't drop the tongs, it's not cool yet.
A bowl of makgeolli and you'll forget it.
For all the sparks, it ended quietly.
Loosen your shoulders. You're making the iron nervous.
A wasted swing, but not wasted effort.
Hmph, the iron's pretending not to hear.
Some days just pass you by. Happens.
Dust off your apron and get back up here.
Hammer hand's intact. That's enough.
It's testing you. Iron acts up around some folks.
Even the forge cat didn't blink.
No big deal. Check the fire once more.
The ring was a bit dull, I'll admit.
Glaring at it won't make the iron stick.
Iron's slow on the uptake today.
shatter: Well, iron scraps are flying everywhere.
That sword held on right to the end, I'll give it that.
That spark sounded ominous. I should've known.
It wasn't my hammer's fault, let's say that.
Even iron cracks when it's held in too long.
Sit down first. Have some water.
Dropping this far, honestly, is almost a relief.
The anvil's gone quiet.
What goes up comes down, iron included.
I'll set aside the usable pieces for you.
At least your hands are fine.
Looks like the sword you first picked up, now.
Heh, didn't expect it to snap so cleanly.
Haven't heard a sound like that in ages.
Back in the fire, then. Nothing else to do.
It's a waste for me too.
For something that broke, it rang pretty clear.
Even the bellows have days like this.
If you're going to cry, do it by the coals. It's warm there.
That sword did its job to the end.
There's plenty of iron to hammer again.
Tch, of all the blades, it had to be your favorite.
Happens often enough, but it still stings.
I've swung a hammer long enough, and I still can't stop this.
It's fine. Melt iron and it's still iron.
That crack must have carried all the way to town.
Straighten up. You'll bring the roof down.
Didn't see this coming, honestly.
Better it breaks all at once than drags on.
Go eat some soup. The iron isn't going anywhere.
Got it all the way up here, and now this.
Only the hilt is left. Hold on to that much.
Well, I didn't know it could shatter this thoroughly.
That sword felt like it was saying hello to me.
Sigh outside the door. You'll put the fire out.
I doubted my own eyes. Breaking? This one?
Standing there silent makes me feel worse than you.
The broken tip is still warm.
Looked fine, and yet it was like that inside. Tch.
Put your apron on. We'll start over from the beginning.
Every time I see a broken blade, it gets to me.
Farewell, you lump of iron. You did well.
Of all places, it had to break in front of me.
The anvil feels colder today.
Not even worth scrap. Sorry about that.
You look strange standing there without a sword.
Thought it might work, but it broke after all.
It wasn't the iron that sweated, it was you.
No gathering those pieces. Just remember how it looked.
I feel empty too. Sending a sword off is always like this.
guard: Didn't expect a scrap of paper to be this reliable.
Was about to fall, but that paper caught me.
Well, would you look at that. Paper beats steel.
My heart nearly dropped before I did.
Guess I owe whoever made that Guard Ticket a drink.
That was close. Took a few years off this old man.
That paper's pulling its weight.
My hammer hand's still shaking. Paper saved me.
I can hammer steel, but I can't beat that paper.
Well, the Guard Ticket held. Now that's something!
Had my eyes shut, and I'm still in one piece.
Sometimes a scrap of paper is worth its weight.
I couldn't have blocked that one myself.
Good thing you kept it. That's what days like this are for.
Held my breath too long. Finally breathing again.
If I'd fallen, I wouldn't have said a word for days.
That paper works as hard as my forge.
Ugly little thing, but the Guard Ticket does its job.
Heh, even the steel went quiet on that one.
Said it was a Guard Ticket. Wasn't just talk.
This is why you stock up on them.
Cold sweat all over. Pass me some water.
I ought to bow to that scrap of paper.
Thought it'd blow. Still in one piece. It worked!
Without that Guard Ticket, I'd have lost my appetite.
That thin thing held. Live long enough, eh!
Wasn't going to praise it, but I'll give that paper credit.
Caught it by a hair. Next time, go easy on my nerves.
Nearly sat down on the floor right there!
Small thing, big job.
Whew. My palms are soaked.
One charm beats a blacksmith, it seems.
Didn't go down after all. Catch your breath.
Without that, I'd be reaching for a smoke right now.
Earned its price. Not a waste.
Stared at the floor for nothing. All fine.
Nearly ruined a perfectly good meal.
Never thought one Guard Ticket could make things this easy.
Don't scare an old man like that!
Just then, the Guard Ticket was more trustworthy than steel.
m10: Well, would you look at that. Can't trust my own eyes.
Hammered metal my whole life, never seen this.
Hold on, let me rub my eyes and look again.
The metal actually obeyed. It never listens to me.
Thought it was a reject. Guess not.
Something's gotten into your hands, huh.
The anvil shook. So did I, a little.
Even I wouldn't have bet on this one.
Wait, this was actually possible?
Tell the old man next door, he won't believe it.
Finished before the quench water cooled.
Hm. Dinner's on me tonight.
Sparks flew, so I figured we'd blown it.
Well, that's a result I never taught you.
Guess this old man still has something to learn.
Lost for words. Guess I need a drink.
The iron smells sweet today.
Alright, I admit it. That surprised me.
Years by the coals, and I still get days like this.
Alright, that's enough from me.
That last one. Can you show me again?
The forge roof rattled. So did my heart.
First time I've heard metal laugh.
Dropped my pipe, I was so stunned.
I don't remember making anything like this.
I won't brag. Much. Only inside.
Can't sell this one. Want to keep an eye on it.
Huh. It really works!
m15: Huh. I hammered it myself and still don't believe it.
Looks like my hammer's smarter than I am.
Hm, the metal must've woken up in a good mood.
Bellows must've caught a good breeze, eh?
Rubbed my eyes, and it's still there.
Never seen metal like this in my whole life.
Not the work of a man who dozed by the fire.
Whoa, the metal's listening to me now.
The fellow next door's going to faint.
The quench water was kind to us today!
Makes no sense, yet it feels right in hand.
Didn't do much. The metal did the rest.
Good grief, the anvil must be shocked.
Guess the hammer earned its keep today.
Figured it would shatter, so I shut my eyes.
I thought this only happened in dreams.
Wait, did I misread? No, it's real.
Saw sparks fly and figured it was over.
Lived long enough to see this, I suppose.
Well tempered. Don't ask me how.
It actually pulled it off, that lump of iron!
Ha, I'm drunk on this without a drop of soju.
Whoa, my hands are still shaking.
Even iron sometimes takes our side.
Shame to sell this. Not that I will.
My eyes are going, I must be seeing things.
Roof might blow off, and I wouldn't be shocked!
Fire burns this pretty on days like this.
m20: I dropped my hammer. Didn't even notice.
Huh. It actually stuck. Can't believe it.
Speechless. For real.
Forty years at the anvil, and never this.
The metal held. The metal, mind you.
Gonna sit by the anvil. My legs gave out.
Didn't notice the forge went cold. Stared too long.
Didn't do this. The steel did it on its own.
Seeing it, and I still can't believe it.
Quench water's gone cold. I was out a while.
You didn't steal this, did you? Never mind.
Well, so this is how it works.
It works. Yep. It works.
Thought my old eyes were playing tricks.
I'm lost for words. Truly.
Watching that nearly stopped my heart.
Forty years of hammering and I still learn something.
Need a drink. Water will do.
The steel's making a weird sound. A good weird.
Too scared to touch it. Might break.
Saying nothing is the biggest compliment I've got.
Hold on. Gonna sit down.
Ha, so the steel does listen sometimes.
Could close up shop now and not regret a thing.
Wonder what my old master would've said.
Hard to act cool with this in front of me.
Hmph. Hm. Fine, good work.
Makes me think of all the ones I broke.
broke: Your pockets are whistling in the wind, huh.
Empty-handed, and you're staring at my hammer.
No gold, no metal moves. Iron's picky that way.
Looking is free. Look all you want.
That purse? Open it and only dust will fly out.
No credit here. My steel would feel hurt.
Warm yourself by the fire today. No charge for that.
Heh, your purse shows plain on your face.
Don't even ask for a discount.
If you feel sorry for the weapon, at least wipe it down.
Walking in broke takes nerve. I'll give you that.
Empty pockets, and you're still standing tall.
Before I hammer anything, go fetch gold off the road.
Haven't seen a customer this broke in ages.
Crying won't work the bellows, you know.
That blade's still usable. Hang on a bit longer.
I'd do it for free if I could. But the rent won't pay itself.
You've forgotten what gold looks like, haven't you?
Here, drink some water. That one's on me.
Next time, come back with a fuller purse.
The hammer's getting bored. Blame yourself.
Your purse is light, but at least your legs are fine.
Go slay a slime around the corner, maybe.
Leaving already? Close the door gently.
Your empty purse rattles all the way over here!
It works? Flat broke, and you still got this far.
I can stoke the fire, but I can't pay for the iron.
Tch, dreaming of upgrades on that budget?
Come back, and I'll hit it with my best hammer.
Your purse is quieter than I am, somehow!
Your whetstone's richer than your wallet, I'd bet.
The anvil's idle today. Blame your wallet.
Before the iron, your finances need heating up.
Asking for an upgrade looking like that? Not happening.
I hammer metal, not empty pockets.
Nice armor, empty pockets.
Should've stuck some gold on your forehead.
Even bellows cost money, you know.
Still, you found my forge. Not bad.
Mention money and you go quiet, huh.

t1: You came in. The door shut on its own.
The floor's still solid. Won't last forever.
Just a warm-up. It still hurts, though.
Coming up, huh. Most just watched and left.
The walls are humming. Not a welcome sound.
Stairs are over there. Not hard to find.
I'm still going easy on you.
Loud steps. Everything in here heard you.
Your legs must be getting shaky about now.
Made it this far. Didn't think that'd work.
The wind up top has changed. Chilly, right?
t2: Didn't expect you to make it this far.
The floors are about to get unfamiliar.
The stairs have always been right here, you know.
Quite high already. Watch your footing.
Still alive this high up? Impressive.
The air's getting thinner up here.
Even I didn't expect you to get this far.
The door's open. Come in or don't.
Still got both legs, I see.
At this height, going back down is the longer way.
This isn't really a place for visitors.
Guess I'm starting to like you.
t3: Back again. The footholds are still holding.
Don't lean on the walls. Fresh paint.
Floor's a bit slick from here on.
Retie your laces before you head in.
This floor's damp. Blame the mold.
Still limping along with that old gear, huh.
Door's open. Whether it closes is your problem.
More stairs again. Don't ask me why.
About now, your legs start to complain.
Lights are out up here. Feel your way.
That gear'll do. Come on in.
t4: You've climbed this far already. The stairs look surprised.
Still standing? Honestly, I'm a little surprised too.
The walls are starting to smell funny.
Didn't expect anyone to climb this high. The way's open, though.
The stairs sound heavier than they did before.
Not many visitors up here, you know.
Whoa. Not many make it this far.
The ceiling seems a bit higher now.
The door opened on its own. Never seen that before.
You'd better retie your laces before going on.
The monsters' eyes already look different.
t5: Past this point, even I've never been this high.
Never seen anyone use my stairs like that.
My blueprints didn't go this far, you know.
Look down. The ground's just dots now.
Thin air up here. Breathe however you can.
Even the monsters didn't expect you this far.
At this height, going back down is the longer trip.
Thought I had no roof. Turns out it's clouds.
The door opened. Didn't think it would, honestly.
Walked all the way up here. Not even birds come.
I'm starting to forget if I built this height.
The village below's out of sight now.

kingslime: Touch me and you'll get sticky. You sure about that?
Softest body on the whole meadow. That's me.
Go ahead, stab me. You'll just sink right in.
Don't judge by size. Inside, I'm even squishier.
Step on this grass and your boots'll stick fast.
That sword I swallowed? Still not digested.
Think I'm easy just because I wobble?
I'm king, so I'm the biggest jelly. Simple as that.
lich: Shoes on, in my tomb? Some manners, huh.
All bones, huh? You'll feel it to the bone.
A guest, finally. Hope you like curses.
My knees creak, but my spells don't!
Just dozing off... and someone's knocking.
Flesh long gone, but my magic's still fresh.
Want the crown? Learn to put bones together.
lavagolem: See the floor melting under me? Your boots are next.
Hot, you say? Sorry, this is just how I am.
Get close and you get roasted. Stay far and you still get a little roasted.
Thought I was just a rock? I am. A rock on fire.
Lots of fools tried to cool me down. All of them went *hiss* and that was that.
Heard you can cook meat on my back. Just a rumor, I hope.
The floor burns wherever I walk. Not my fault.
You made it all the way here. Hope your soles are still intact.
wyrm: This whole valley is my freezer.
One breath from me and your sword becomes an icicle.
Came dressed warm, I see. Won't help.
One snort and your eyebrows will frost over.
You dare fight me on this ice?
Cold? I think this is a mild day for me.
I'm holding back a sneeze, so watch out.
I was sleeping in peace. Who's knocking?
demonlord: Been sitting on this throne so long my back's killing me.
You think that weapon's enough to beat me? Well, come on, then.
I just had this cape made. Don't you dare scuff it.
Someone actually made it this far? Honestly, I'm a little surprised.
The Dark Lord himself shows up and you couldn't even clap?
I'd give up on going home alive, if I were you.
I practiced my lines for days, and now I've forgotten them.
You've got some nerve, walking into my castle!
tidewyrm: Open the floodgate and you're soaked from the feet up.
I yawn, and the whole sea spills over.
I just shut the gates. Why are you back already?
Forget the waves. Barnacles on my scales bug me more.
Behind this gate, the whole ocean is waiting.
You came ready to get wet, right? No time to dry off.
You walked all the way here? Can you even swim?
The floodgate lever is right under my tail.
swampqueen: If you dipped your feet in my swamp, you pay the price.
Smell's bad? Turn around. I like it.
My poison's slow, but it always gets there. Don't worry.
Squishy ground, huh? That's my taste.
The frogs are already whispering about you.
I'm the law here. Swamp law, of course.
Perfect timing. The swamp was getting boring.
Hear the bubbling? That's applause for you.
crystcolossus: Blinding, right? I polished them myself this morning.
Hit me and your fist hurts first, I bet.
Little thing, crawling in here without a shred of fear!
Don't mind the cracks. That's just the pattern.
Use me as a mirror if you like. All it will show is your end.
Getting this far is impressive, honestly.
Break me if you can. Go on, then.
Echoes like that? Caves do that, you know.
stormcaptain: My knees ache from coming down through the clouds.
That flash is lightning, not my armor polish.
If the wind suddenly picks up, that's me. Be ready.
You can still turn back if you don't want to get rained on.
Did you bring an umbrella? It's gonna be damp down here.
The cape flapping isn't for show, you know.
Didn't look so small from up in the sky. Huh.
You heard that thunder? That was my cough.
voidlord: Nothing here, right? It's all mine.
Got rid of the throne. Empty air is more comfy.
It's not empty. Call it negative space.
No walls, no floor, and you're still standing. Impressive.
Go ahead, shout. Not even an echo comes back.
No cleaning needed. Even the dust ran off.
Don't mock me for being hollow. It's my job.
I put the lights out. Darkness sets the mood.
sandcolossus: Got sand in your boots? That's all part of me.
One swing of my arm and the desert changes shape.
No rain, and I'm invincible. Don't bring rain.
Tried to roar, but sand keeps getting in my mouth.
Thirsty? No water here. Just sand.
Don't mind the bits falling off when I move.
Small one, walking all the way out here. Brave, or dumb?
Falling apart's no big deal. I just pile back up. How about you?
steamgeneral: Better leave before my boiler heats up.
Hiss-hiss. Scared of a little steam? That's just how I sound.
My valve leaks a bit, but you're still no match.
If my knee creaks, you didn't hear it.
I haven't been oiled in ages. Watch yourself.
Once the smokestack smokes, I'm serious.
Missing a few gears still makes a general a general.
That hiss was a threat. You're allowed to flinch.
thunderdragon: Ever been struck by lightning? I get hit daily. Still fine.
Touch my scales and you'll feel a zap. A big one.
Static's bad today. Even I'm getting shocked.
Not a cloud in sight, yet thunder's coming. That'd be me.
That crackling breath? Not a malfunction.
When the sky rumbles, that's me. Or my stomach.
Brought a lightning rod? Won't help you much.
It'll be over in a blink. Go on, blink.
mirrorlord: Swing your sword first, I'll copy you.
Hit me and you'll hurt too, probably.
You've got something on your face... oh, that's mine.
Wiping won't help. I'll just reflect again.
Ignore the cracks. This is how I always look.
Don't like that expression? I'll return it.
Dodge if you want. I'll dodge too.
Go fix your hair, I'll wait.
forgegod: I was the first to ever pound a hammer in this world.
That anvil you're holding? It used to be my chair.
The first ember in the world came from my forge, you know.
Enhancing? I made that up to pass the time.
You've got nerve, stepping past the first forge's doorway.
Even the wind lines up before my bellows.
Challenging the original without knowing it? Hurts a little.
Even the iron in your hand is mine, if you think about it.
frostking: The icicles on my crown aren't decorative. They hurt.
You made it all this way. Your feet aren't cold?
I am the Frozen King. My joints are just a bit stiff.
One breath and it all freezes. Your snot's already frozen, I see.
Kneel. Not that I can, mind you. I'm frozen solid.
Getting up is a hassle. Just stand there and wait.
Your breath is showing. Must be chilly out there.
There was never any heating. Get used to it.
skywhale: Standing under my shadow was your first mistake.
Does a whale fly? Even I'm still amazed by it.
The fountain shoots cannonballs, not water.
I'm about to sing. You might want to cover your ears.
Once you're in my belly, there's no way out. Probably.
A giant like me floating over the clouds? What's to fear?
Just a wag of my tail and your roof is gone.
My sails are torn? Eh, I'm a whale. I'll be fine.
clockwarden: Hear the ticking? That's your time left.
I hate it when people are late for appointments.
Just oiled up. No squeaks today, see?
Getting caught in the gears hurts, so I hear.
Bell time! Spring's not fully wound, but it'll do.
Rust is just for show. Don't underestimate me.
Time's on my side. Until my spring runs down, anyway.
Footsteps in my tower? At least keep the beat.
chief: See my crown? It's not a pot lid.
My boys stepped out. Just me is plenty.
This is our turf, so take off your shoes.
My club's a little worn, but it still hurts!
Smell? That's just the chief's dignity.
Got anything shiny? Hand it over and I'll let you off easy.
I'm the biggest around here. Probably.
I just left my dinner. Let's make this quick.
gravekeeper: My shovel's a bit heavy. You'll find out once you take a swing.
Saw an empty plot. Figured it'd fit you just right.
Pulling a night shift and a customer walks right in. Lovely.
Keep it down. Everyone here is trying to sleep.
Hey, stop right there! Get off my grass!
Nobody in this town digs better than me.
Still haven't decided what to carve on your headstone.
You're not scared, are you? Gotta admit, this line feels a little silly to say.
salamander: Floor's warm, right? I warmed it up for you.
Better leave before your soles melt.
Don't step on my tail. I mean it.
A body that melts rock. What made you think you'd win?
Don't come any closer. I'm a little hot myself.
I harden when I cool, so this ends quick.
Plenty of people have boiled ramen on my back.
glacierbear: Better turn back before your snot freezes.
All this ice is mine. Stepping on it costs you.
I was napping and woke up in a bad mood.
Your footsteps are too loud. I thought you were a salmon.
My fur's warm inside. If you can get in, that is.
I can put up with melting glaciers. Not uninvited guests.
Your breath's already turning white, huh.
I thought you were a snack. You look pretty filling, though.
executioner: Darkness sent for me, so I came myself.
Verdict's in. You're just the last to know.
Run now if you're running. I'm busy today.
Just getting this far breaks the rules.
This axe's edge is dull, but the mood's fine!
Standing in the dark too long. My legs ache.
This black cloak's oddly hot. Let's finish fast.
coralcrab: Don't underestimate me just because I walk sideways.
Think these claws are just for decoration?
Can't you see the coral on my back? It's a crown.
This whole sandbar is my front yard.
Better back off before you get boiled.
Head-on fights aren't my thing. I only go sideways.
Don't think you can take me lightly just because I'm foaming.
This crown's heavy, so I can't play with you for long.
bogtoad: You walked into my swamp in shoes?
Ribbit, I mean... no. Just come at me!
One flick of my tongue and you're fly food.
Good luck running in this muck.
Just ate. Oh good, more food walked in.
Trust me, I hop better than you do.
Don't laugh at the damp. It bites back.
One burp and your hat's gone.
crystscorp: My shell's a bit shiny, huh? Close your eyes if it's too bright.
See the venom on this tail? Oh, wait, it's crystal. Can't see it.
My claws look like glass? Get cut once and you'll think differently.
If you're gonna shatter me, be ready. The shards sting.
I look best in sunlight, but this is a cave. Too bad.
Want past? Go through me first. The dazzling me.
Stop staring. That's your own face you're seeing.
My armor's a gem. Look all you want, but don't touch.
griffin: You dare walk across my airspace? Bold.
Spread my wings once and your hat's gone.
I'm the highest thing in the sky. Except that cloud.
Perfect timing, I was just sharpening my claws.
Head of an eagle, body of a lion. Pick your fight.
Coming down is a hassle. Why'd you come up here?
Go ahead, pull a feather. Good luck with that.
I've been watching you from above this whole time, pal.
voideye: Saw everything. Even that whiff earlier.
No eyelids, so I'm always tired. Let's make this quick.
I'm not glaring. This is just my face.
I can't see behind me, so come at me from the front.
Eye contact made. Guess running's off the table.
Gonna put in some eye drops. Stay right there.
Catch my gaze and it'll sting. Fair warning!
sandmummy: Got sand in my mouth. Threats can wait.
Don't look at the unwrapped parts. It's embarrassing.
You woke me up. Now you own that.
